name: PhysGaussian
definition: A method using the Material Point Method (MPM) over Gaussians, providing one representation for both rendering and simulation of materials like cloth, jelly, sand, and snow.
summary: PhysGaussian is a physical simulation pipeline that treats 3D Gaussian primitives as Material Point Method particles to model soft tissue deformation and motion, coupling 3D Gaussian Splatting with continuum mechanics for unified rendering and simulation.
